summary.text: Angela Jones is the Democratic candidate for Michigan House of Representatives District 37 in the November 3, 2026 general election; the incumbent is Brad Paquette (R).
A photographer, she was also the Democratic nominee in the district in 2024, when Paquette won the general election.

paragraphs.text: Angela Jones was born in Irving, Texas, graduated from St. Joseph High School, and attended Lake Michigan College and The Art Institute.
Her career experience includes working as a photographer.
In a Ballotpedia survey in 2024, she described herself as the owner of a photography studio in downtown Buchanan and of an online coloring book business, and as a single parent.
Jones advanced from the Democratic primary on August 4, 2026, after also advancing from the Democratic primary in 2024.

In the 2024 survey she listed protecting workers' rights, supporting sustainable agriculture, and expanding access to affordable healthcare, education and economic opportunity as the main points of her campaign.
